description: Real-time price updates every time a match happens with batching for cascading matches
send_interval: Every trade match (batched for cascading matches)

unsubscribe_request.product_ids: optional - specific products to unsubscribe from

notes: Ticker channel provides real-time price and volume data with best bid/ask. High frequency updates. Use ticker_batch for reduced frequency (5-second updates).
use_case: Real-time price tracking, bid/ask monitoring, volume analysis
comparison_to_ticker_batch: ticker: every trade match (high frequency) vs ticker_batch: every 5 seconds
